checkpoint: Minimum selection sparse cross-entropy, including epoch zero; joint restore of classifier and gate
primary_metric: accuracy; paired task-minus-raw differences in percentage points
scope: Single-factor selector-side component RMS normalization; original-amplitude reconstruction; explored TRAIN-only splits.
fixed_ssa_rule: Per-sample smallest prefix explaining >=90% trajectory singular-value squared energy. No labels or held-out tuning.
scale: One scalar mean/std fitted on fit input values only; applied to all raw samples before SSA. No separate output normalization.
budget: Three new task branches x60epochs,2400 head and classifier updates each; all five existing60epoch controls reused read-only. Same pretrain weights, batch order, optimizer, LR and checkpoint budget.
stop_rule: Execute all3seeds at60epochs, selection CE best including0; report all seeds and40/50/60best/terminal without selecting by assessment. No noise/SRD/official TEST.
normalization_rule: Each selector component divided by max(RMS,0.001), no centering. Floor fixed engineering choice in standardized raw units; limits amplification to1000; numerical residual stays near zero. Does not normalize reconstruction or downstream classifier input.
